text: China's September PPI rises 5% annually versus 4.5% expected, up from 3.8% in August. CPI increases 0.9%, with core CPI at 1%. Gasoline prices rise 16.6%, while food prices decline 1.7%. Producer and consumer inflation remain separated by 4.1 percentage points.

meta.note: The producer-consumer inflation gap is observed; transmission into downstream prices remains unmeasured.

text: ASML reports Q3 net profit of €4.96B versus €4.1B expected and sales of €11.66B versus €11.72B. Customer demand exceeds planned 2027-2028 capacity, with order interest extending to 2030. Full-year sales guidance rises to €44B–€45B.

meta.note: Interest in 2029-2030 orders is not confirmed bookings; the reported capacity gap reflects company forecasts.

text: The IEA reports September diesel exports down 700,000 barrels daily year-over-year, with Russia and the Middle East down 1.3M barrels daily. Inventories decline amid resilient diesel demand. The agency projects Q4 2026 supply below demand and inventory replenishment no earlier than H2 2027.

meta.note: Inventory recovery timing is an IEA projection; proposed Russian supply volumes are not confirmed delivered quantities.
